opportunities.name: Company account brief email
opportunities.description: For a given ticker/company, look up the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and email an account brief to a colleague.
steps: Search the ticker on SEC EDGAR and open the company result
Open Form filter and the 10-K annual report to get the filing date
Search the company on Wikipedia and read HQ, employees, CEO
Compose email to recipient with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body summarising HQ, employees, CEO, latest 10-K date

opportunities.name: Two-city time difference and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: Use timeanddate time zone converter for two cities, check holidays of the country for a month, and email ops with the time difference and dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Open Calendar > Holidays and select the country/month
Email ops with subject 'Sync: <City1> / <City2>, <Month>' with hour difference and dates to avoid

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India, October, avoid Oct 2 and 20
